name: jsonvet
description: A linter for JSON, I-JSON, JSONC, JWCC (HuJSON), JSON5 and JSON Lines. It reports syntax errors, duplicate keys, each dialect's rules and JSON Schema errors, all with exact positions. The schema comes from --schema, a config file or a file's own $schema. On a terminal, each problem shows as a code frame, and --color controls the color. It also writes SARIF for GitHub code scanning and JSON for scripts and editors. A playground runs it in the browser as WebAssembly. It ships as a pre-commit hook, PyPI wheels, Rust crates, release binaries and a GitHub Action. The repository includes a conformance matrix of JSON5, JSONC, JWCC and JSON Lines parsers.
